Future<void> run(items, step) async {
 await inOrder(items, step, reason: orderReason);
}
class Runner {
 Future<void> run(items, step) async {
  await inOrderSteps([step], reason: orderReason);
 }
 Future<void> shadow(items, step, String orderReason) async {
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrder(items, step, reason: orderReason);
 }
}
const String orderReason = 'Each update reads the previous write';
Future<void> short(items, step) async {
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
 await inOrder(items, step, reason: shortReason);
}
const String shortReason = 'too short';
